summary_en: This Phase 1/Phase 2 study tests AZD5335 (torvutatug samrotecan), an antibody-drug conjugate, alone or with other anti-cancer drugs, in people with solid tumors, including ovarian cancer, lung adenocarcinoma, endometrial cancer, and lung squamous cell carcinoma. Torvutatug samrotecan is given by IV infusion, saruparib and palacaparib are taken by mouth, and the dosing schedule and how often each drug is given are not stated. The study aims to assess safety, tolerability, and anti-cancer activity, and a specific primary outcome measure is not stated.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 1/fase 2 evalúa AZD5335 (torvutatug samrotecan), un conjugado anticuerpo-fármaco, solo o combinado con otros medicamentos contra el cáncer, en personas con tumores sólidos, incluidos cáncer de ovario, adenocarcinoma de pulmón, cáncer endometrial y carcinoma escamoso de pulmón. El torvutatug samrotecan se administra por infusión intravenosa, el saruparib y el palacaparib se toman por vía oral, y el esquema de dosis y la frecuencia de cada medicamento no se indican. El estudio busca evaluar la seguridad, la tolerabilidad y la actividad contra el cáncer, y no se indica una medida de resultado principal específica.
who_for: Adults aged 18 years or older who can give informed consent
Advanced solid tumor with measurable disease per RECIST v1.1
Life expectancy of at least 12 weeks
Prior adequate therapy, or investigator judges a trial to be the best next option
not_for: Spinal cord compression or history of leptomeningeal carcinomatosis
Brain metastases that are symptomatic, unstable, or need high-dose steroids
Active infection, or hepatitis or HIV not controlled as described in the criteria
History of non-infectious lung inflammation (ILD/pneumonitis) needing steroids or oxygen
Uncontrolled hypertension, recent heart attack or stroke, or QTcF above 470 msec
